title: Getting Started with Next.js
excerpt: Learn the basics of building modern web applications with Next.js and React.
content:
# Getting Started with Next.js

## What is Next.js?
Next.js is a React framework that makes building fast, scalable web applications easier.

## Why use Next.js?
- Server-side rendering
- Static site generation
- API routes
- Built-in optimization

## Getting Started
1. Install Next.js with npx create-next-app@latest
2. Run npm run dev to start the development server
3. Open http://localhost:3000 in your browser

That's it! You're ready to start building.
author: John Doe

title: Understanding React Hooks
excerpt: A comprehensive guide to React Hooks and how to use them in your components.
content:
# Understanding React Hooks

## What are Hooks?
Hooks are functions that let you use state and other React features in functional components.

## Common Hooks
- useState: Manage component state
- useEffect: Handle side effects
- useContext: Access context values
- useReducer: Complex state management

## Benefits
1. Reuse stateful logic
2. Organize code by concern
3. Avoid wrapper hell

Hooks make React more powerful and flexible than ever before.
author: Jane Smith

title: Static Site Generation Best Practices
excerpt: Learn how to build fast and performant static sites using Next.js SSG.
content:
# Static Site Generation Best Practices

## What is SSG?
Static Site Generation (SSG) pre-renders pages at build time, resulting in highly optimized static HTML files.

## Advantages
- Lightning-fast page loads
- Better SEO
- Reduced server costs
- Improved security

## Best Practices
1. Use getStaticProps for data fetching
2. Pre-render only critical pages
3. Use ISR for dynamic content updates
4. Optimize images and assets

SSG is perfect for blogs, documentation, and marketing sites.
author: Bob Johnson
